label: Scene Template: Kinetic List
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: 3-6 parallel things told as a SEQUENCE (launch-film grammar, not a slide). Setup headline owns the center, then each item TAKES OVER the full frame in turn -- giant type-on label, ghost index numeral as a parallax depth layer, progress tracker ticking -- and the compact list only assembles at the end as the payoff. theme 'dark' for the dark variant.
